_readme: Service categories. Add your own by adding an entry with a new id; everyone gets a random skill and comfort level for it.
th = lewdness she needs to enjoy it (trust can stretch her up to 25 below). price = base fee. energy = what it costs her.
desc = what the service is, in plain words; the AI prompts get "label (desc)" as {service} so the AI knows what you mean.

minCloth = the least undressed she'll be in images of it by default (dressed, partial, under, nude). Above partial it only applies if she's comfortable that far; Modest ladies still keep things pulled aside.

image.client / image.sam / image.duo = pose and framing for client scenes, Sam's first-person scenes, and scenes with two ladies. Each is a list: one is picked at random per image, so add variants. image.extra is added to every image of this service (this replaces the old act_<id> snippets).
report = lines for the weekly report when a client got this service (one is picked at random; empty falls back to flavor.json client_yes).
